name: white.test
title: White's neural-network test for a series. The phantom directions are runif, then the principal-component scores from the second column on.

origin.description: White's neural-network test for a series. The phantom directions are runif, then the principal-component scores from the second column on.

arguments.name: x
arguments.text: The series, matrix, or path this function accepts.

origin.details: White's neural-network test for a series. The phantom directions are runif, then the principal-component scores from the second column on.
origin.value: The same value tseries 0.10-63 returns for this case, written as one line.
origin.example:
set.seed(1)
w <- white.test(ts(sin((1:40)/3) + 0.1 * (1:40)), q = 4, qstar = 1)
paste(cell(w$statistic), cell(w$p.value), sep = "|")

translation.example:
set_seed(1)
x = np.array([math.sin(i / 3) + 0.1 * i for i in range(1, 41)])
w = white_test(x, q=4, qstar=1)
